name: smwgraphics-super-mario-all-stars-super-mario-advance-4-super-mario-bros
title: Super Mario All-Stars / Super Mario Advance 4: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Mario
description:
Mirann/Pac's description: The SMB3 Mario graphics, assembled to be used with the 32x32 Character Tilemap Kit patch. This includes the SMAS and SMA4 versions, as well a "custom" one (made of minor edits from the SMA4 version).

More information in the readme!

KPhoenix's description: Provides a full range of Mario frames for all the original SMW Mario animations in the style of SMAS. (Note: This pack is the only SMAS: SMB3 Mario graphics available. All other sets are based on SMA4: SMB3)

mod edit: combined with kphoenix's submission which doesn't require the 32x32 character tilemap kit patch while mirann and pac's does.
